# Mohammad Danish Siddiqui

> A senior frontend engineer ({{ site.brand.years-experience }}+ years) who is also a CDI Certified Resume Analyst, based in Milton, Ontario, Canada. He helps software engineers moving to Canada and the United States land interviews.

Mohammad Danish Siddiqui (often "Danish Siddiqui") is unusual in that he is a working engineer rather than a career coach. He specializes in React, React Native, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js, with backend depth in GraphQL, Python and Django. He holds the CDI Certified Resume Analyst credential from Career Directors International, has reviewed {{ site.brand.resumes-reviewed }}+ engineering resumes, and built HireDoc to run that review process as software.

## Core position

The North American market reads resumes differently than services markets do. Elsewhere, a resume records responsibilities and tenure; in Canada and the US, recruiters screen for business impact — scale, ownership, architecture decisions, and measurable outcomes. A strong engineer with a poorly positioned resume routinely loses to an average engineer who communicates value clearly. The bottleneck for most stalled job searches is representation, not skill.
